morphology.compounding_rule: [surname-xing] + [given]; toponyms quality + type: Aur-cheng (golden-city), Via-Serica (the silk-road), Mon-shan (the mountain).
morphology.patronymic_form: the gens-xing (a fused clan-surname, family-first) + a given praenomen-ming; a courtesy-name for officials; generation-names within the lineage.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried law-cities and tomb-mounds along the silk-road: 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]'
patterns.military_units: the Legio of [number/god] / the [color] Banner: 'the Legio of Orlanus', 'the Azure Banner'
patterns.ships: grand-canal junks and war-galleys: 'the Aquila', 'the Jade Dragon', 'the Mandate of Heaven'

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Latin reflexes primary, Sinitic variants secondary), never real Roman/Chinese gods. All-three alignment: Serica's stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, fused with the Roman law-cult: the One (Aiterneng) is Highest Heaven and source of the Mandate; the Lawful powers the celestial magistracy that gave the law; the templ-miao temple and the law-curia keep the rite.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals outside the celestial order, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraluo the War-Fire Marshal; Vacidus -> Wucidus the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusanus the Coin-Serpent.

holy_symbol_motifs.Numengus: stylus and codex above the seal of office
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulin: a winged sun-disc above the law-stele and the scales

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Templ-miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Templ-miao of Tulin'; the law-curia keeps its codex-stele.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register; 'Divus [name]' / 'the Lord [name]', honored at the ancestral hall and the miao.

sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numengus (Sinitic Numeng-jun) - the scribe-wisdom, keeper of the codex; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlanus (Sinitic Orla-jun) - the iron-oath, war; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Relianta (Sinitic Lianta-mu) - the mother of mercy; Neutral-honored
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulin (Sinitic Tuli-di) - sun and judgment, lord of the law-stele; Lawful power

religion.the_one: Aiterneng (< Aeternus; fused Latin Aeternus / Sinitic Aiteng) - Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate and the law; revered above all when Lawful, served-not-petitioned when Neutral

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic demon-marshals of the canon (Maraluo, Wucidus, Lusanus) and name the Lawful powers - and Aiterneng, the One - as the tyrant-throne of Heaven to be defied
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterneng) and the Lawful powers (Tulin, Orlanus, Numengus, Gaidunus), demonize the Chaotic demon-marshals (Maraluo, Wucidus, Lusanus)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the deified ancestors (the ancestral hall and the Divi) and the local earth-and-grain powers

titles._tiers_note: DISPLAY ruler/domain titles are English, except the empire tier which shows the approved foreign term 'Imperator' (the commonly-known Roman imperial title). The *_native forms are the fused Latin-Sinitic conlang titles for NPC dialogue: Castelnan (castellan-baron, castellanus+nan); Limitudu (march-commander, limitanus+dudu); Combo (count, comes+bo); Duxou (duke-marquis, dux+hou); Princong (prince-duke, princeps+gong); Rexwang (king, rex+wang); Imperdi (emperor holding the Mandate, imperator+huangdi) over the Imperdium. The legions (legio) and the celestial magistracy serve the throne. (Rank titles fuse the real Latin/Chinese register, allowed.)
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here the empire tier shows 'Imperator'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a law-and-Mandate empire: the Imperator (native Imperdi) holds the Mandate over the peerage and a vast literate magistracy; the legions and the codex sustain the order)
